about.title: Watsonville Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Losing someone to a traffic collision on Main Street, Freedom Boulevard, or another Santa Cruz County road changes everything overnight. Santa Cruz County recorded 2 traffic deaths alongside 106 injury collisions in the most recent full year, numbers that represent real families now facing funeral costs, lost income, and an unbearable quiet at home. California law allows a spouse, domestic partner, or children to pursue a wrongful death claim, with other dependents sometimes eligible depending on the family structure. These claims can recover funeral and burial expenses, the financial support the person would have provided, and compensation for the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. LawProactive doesn't practice law ourselves; we're a free service that connects Watsonville families with an independent personal injury attorney who handles these cases on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless money is recovered. You focus on your family. We'll help you find someone who can walk through what happened and what comes next.

items.title: Only Certain Family Members Can File
items.desc: California limits who has standing to bring a wrongful death claim, generally a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children first, with other dependents eligible in some situations. An attorney can clarify who in your family qualifies.

items.title: The Clock Is Running
items.desc: Wrongful death claims in California generally must be filed within two years of the date of death, and that window shrinks significantly if a government entity, like a public roadway agency, may be involved. Waiting too long can close the door on a claim entirely.

items.title: Recoverable Losses Go Beyond Bills
items.desc: Beyond funeral costs and lost financial support, California law recognizes the loss of a loved one's companionship, guidance, and affection as a compensable harm, separate from any criminal proceedings connected to the crash.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim connected to any criminal charges against the driver?
items.answer: No, they're separate. A criminal case is brought by the state and focuses on punishment, while a wrongful death claim is a civil action pursued by family members seeking compensation. One can proceed regardless of the outcome of the other.

items.question: How much time do we have to file a wrongful death claim in Watsonville?
items.answer: California generally allows two years from the date of death, but that period is shorter if a government entity, such as one responsible for a Santa Cruz County road, may bear responsibility. Speaking with an attorney early helps protect your family's options.

items.question: Does it matter that the crash happened on a road like Freedom Boulevard or Airport Boulevard?
items.answer: Public crash data for corridors like these can help an attorney understand collision patterns and evaluate a claim, but every case depends on its own facts. The specific road doesn't change your family's legal rights under California law.

items.question: What does LawProactive actually do for us?
items.answer: We're a free connection service, not a law firm, so we don't handle your case directly. Instead, we introduce Watsonville families to an independent personal injury attorney who works on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless they recover compensation for you.
